title: Past gift and a later naming assurance
shortTitle: Past gift and a later naming assurance
summary: A benefactor’s completed contribution and a later assurance about an institution’s name raise the timing problem associated with past consideration.
notes: What was promised at each stage, and what conduct was sought in exchange for each promise? Is the old gift being used as the price of a later undertaking, or is there a separate later exchange? Read the Prentis problem in full before assigning a final result.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 73–74. Open assigned page 73.
